definitions: First unit survival: alive through global turn 2; reply removal means destroyed on turn 2, regardless of attribution.
First five turns: board difference at the last sampled state in global turn 5, conditional on reaching it.
Mana efficiency: paid / (turn-start max mana plus actual gained mana), includes capacity remaining at game end.
Zero attack exposure counts unit/global-turn observations; weakened-death lag is conditional on observed death.
Clover follow-up spend is descriptive after any clover gain, not causal attribution.

limitations: Fixed policies, no human or online validation. No changes to AI, mana, victory, maps other than opt-in Heart.
Completed games only in aggregates. Unresolved and processing errors reported separately.
Survival includes terminal censored units. Extra-HP absorption and prevented damage are attribution estimates.
A-D arms isolate individual factors; E interactions are not fully separated by this five-arm design.
Requested-minus-actual is overkill, including self damage and hero/counter damage. All first damage timings refer to attack hits against hero.
